lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, spanning the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, forming a grid where the highest-intensity blobs serve as primary intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (top) to shadow (bottom).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs concentrated toward the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit exhibits a dense cluster of micro-spots with higher spatial frequency and smaller diameter than the flank blobs.
